'''Stick''' is the second strongest troll on [[Death Plateau (area)|Death Plateau]]. Players wishing to fight him should be careful, as he is stronger than the other trolls in the area that can hit a max of 244. Since he only attacks with melee, the [[Protect from Melee]] prayer may be useful for fighting him. Like the rest of the trolls in the area, such as [[Rock (Troll)|Rock]], [[Pee Hat]], and [[Kraka]], he may drop a [[granite shield]], which other trolls would not drop.

Trolls are named after the first thing they eat, so he probably ate a stick.

==Trivia==
* Stick originally had a combat level of 104, but it was increased to 141 with the release of [[Troll Warzone]]. The same update also increased the combat level of his partner, [[Rock (monster)|Rock]], from 111 to 157.
